review_basis.method: Independent needs-to-understand review against glossary context.blocked_future_concepts and required facts; no deterministic gates rerun and no generator reasoning consulted.

coverage.text_review: Exhaustive over lesson and remediation text, including titles, ledes, prose, syntax, diagram labels and alternative text, media summaries and bridges, and up-next text. Referenced registry evidence was also inspected.
coverage.sampling_method: One primary interaction per tile (12/34, approximately one third), mixing choice, classification and evidence selection; additional interactions inspected where visible. Prompts, options/items/tasks and feedback reviewed for dependence on future concepts.

findings_summary: No reviewed text or sampled interaction requires understanding a blocked future concept.
Up-next previews name later topics without requiring their mechanisms to be understood.

Generic supplied approval, stop criteria and evidence-recording language is supported by the current concepts; it does not require later manual-promotion approval, automated-response approval mechanisms or incident-documentation procedures.
Teardown explicitly excludes billing verification without requiring residual-charge investigation. Backend setup does not require later state locking or state-access isolation mechanisms.
Clustered concepts are taught in separate local sequences before their respective checks and joint recaps; later cluster members are not needed to understand earlier members.

Restoration readiness checks and workload health checks use locally taught supplied observations, without requiring later RTO/RPO rehearsal verification, endpoint cutover or release smoke-check reporting.
